newsitem.title: NEPAL: Nepal rupee lower vs dlr, weakens on NOC payment.
newsitem.headline: Nepal rupee lower vs dlr, weakens on NOC payment.

text.p: The Nepali rupee opened lower at 57.05/10 rupees per dollar on Thursday, compared to the previous close of 57.03 rupees, and is seen weakening further, dealers said.

"The rupee is expected to weaken further and may touch a level of 57.10 rupees per dollar, as there is a large demand of $12 million for the imports of petroleum products by the state owned Nepal Oil Corporation (NOC)," a dealer said.
Nepal Rastra Bank, the kingdom's central bank, quoted its rupee-dollar rate at 56.75-57.30 rupees per dollar.
Inter-bank call money rates opened at 3.00-3.40 percent on Thursday, against the previous 4.0-5.0 percent, a dealer said.
The lack of demand for funds and improved liquidity conditions are the major causes for the lower call levels, he said.
